provenance: Entirely synthetic Persian source units and authored questions for the fictional Sepehr test service; no customer data or real service policy.
hash_policy: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, no NaN; insensitive to file newline/indentation

review.method: Source-grounding review of all 60 questions, exact evidence spans, scope contrasts, missing-information cases, graded relevance and split intent families; see REVIEW.md. Independent human/domain review remains pending.

grades.0: irrelevant, wrong scope, or insufficient to support this question

relevance_policy.answerability: Only the supplied frozen corpus counts. Missing details are unanswerable; a documented negative answer is answerable.
